coverage_notes.role: Bounded supplementary recall only; production national collector remains authoritative.
searched_classes: hospital, emergency department and maternity service loss
behavioral health, dialysis and oncology service loss
rural, emergency and primary care closure/suspension
CMS provider termination, rescission and CLIA sanctions
concrete re-openings of previously lost essential services
exclusion_notes: Oct 8 Beacon reporting of Fitzgibbon (Marshall, MO) maternity services ending in September is an existing Care Line historical event, care-line-2026-09-30-fitzgibbon-inpatient-labor-delivery-closure.
Oct 8 WAND report on Heritage Oasis Day and Resource Center in Decatur, IL: closure is of shelter/day resources and referrals, not substantiated healthcare treatment service.
Oct 8 Axios story on new Michigan psychiatric hospital: opening is scheduled later in the fall, not an effective restoration of a previously lost service.
Storm-related October 9-10 outpatient closure notices for Northwest Florida were already surfaced in prior recall checks, and are outside this check's new-findings criterion.
Other results are stale, proposals, non-US, or national trend stories without a new specific access change.
limitations: Publication time is unavailable for some search results; no claim is made that all 12 searches exhaustively cover every state.
Primary production collector and its review queue were not modified.
